claim_under_test: The v0 synthetic deontic corpus is ready for semantic promotion.
falsifier: A re-sealed record outside the declared IR is accepted, a required lifecycle distinction is absent, or nominal variation collapses under role-normalized behavior.
observed: The frozen v0 oracle accepted re-sealed hostile records; deadline data did not distinguish timely from late performance; contrary-to-duty repair exposed the wrong executable relationship; the corpus had only 49 role-normalized behaviors; and its counterfactual rows were unexecuted proposals.
authority_boundary: The deterministic v0 shards remain useful hostile-regression fixtures. They are not law, ethics, world truth, or an authorization source.

claim_under_test: The v1 generator and independent oracle agree on every canonical record.
falsifier: Any ordinal whose independently reconstructed normalized result differs from the generator candidate result.
observed: At ordinal 12336, coordinate (3,0,0,3,0,0), the generator emitted an extra lifecycle_blocked_unknown reason while the independent oracle emitted only unknown_lifecycle.
decision: The generator was repaired, then exhaustive canonical verification accepted all 65,536 generated records.
authority_boundary: The repair establishes agreement for the frozen bounded profile only. It does not establish general deontic correctness.

claim_under_test: A counterfactual receipt proves that both endpoint cases were independently verified.
falsifier: Construct a VerifiedCase value with forged identity, normalized result, status, fallback, or hashes and obtain an accepted receipt or analyzer result.
observed: A peer audit found that an earlier receipt path trusted caller-supplied VerifiedCase fields and used a broad axis dependency closure.
decision: The public receipt path now rebuilds and reconciles both endpoints. The analyzer snapshots its input, rebuilds every supplied case once, seals the canonical set, and rejects mismatches with verified_case_tamper. Field-level axis closure is exact.
authority_boundary: Passing adversarial unit tests does not replace a bound mutation campaign or external independent implementation.

claim_under_test: Exhaustive checked negative knowledge is cheap enough for routine iteration.
falsifier: A complete 393,216-pair run takes materially longer than the bounded campaign budget or requires weakening endpoint reconciliation.
observed: After eliminating 786,432 repeated endpoint rebuilds, the exact in-memory analyzer still required 915.148 seconds for 65,536 cases and 393,216 receipts.
decision: Retain full endpoint reconciliation. The next safe optimization target is block-local semantic-core reuse plus diff and hash reuse, not weaker checking.
authority_boundary: This timing is one local bounded run, not a cross-machine benchmark.

claim_under_test: The current run is durably registered in Research Kernel and PopperPad.
falsifier: The Research Kernel MCP methods or PopperPad executable are unavailable, or no successful export receipt is produced.
observed: No Research Kernel MCP methods and no PopperPad executable were available in the active checkout, so no external ledger receipt was produced.
decision: Mark both tool lanes SKIP and retain this local append-only import outbox. SKIP supplies no positive evidence.
authority_boundary: This file is a project-local handoff artifact, not a Research Kernel or PopperPad integrity receipt.

claim_under_test: A separate execution at the frozen hashes reproduces the exhaustive analyzer aggregates and receipt-set root.
falsifier: Any accepted-count, normalized-class, pair-classification, spanning-effect, outcome, or receipt-root mismatch.
observed: A peer execution rebuilt all cases in 334.460 seconds and analyzed them in 560.845 seconds, 895.305 seconds total. It matched 65,536 accepted cases, 322 normalized classes, 177,600 effects, 215,616 invariants, 3,072 spanning effects, the three outcome counts, and receipt-set root 9ccf9ae8d13c9b4fb12cee0503af4010a35ac73c75b3457c4fda528c21a0c2ab.
decision: Retain as same-implementation reproducibility evidence. Do not count it as G11 independent-call-graph or mutation evidence.
authority_boundary: The rerun used the frozen analyzer implementation and does not prove the shared semantics specification correct.
